entity: Arizona overdose deaths, 12 months to Oct 2025, vs the national decline
why: KJZZ, KTAR, CDC and AZPHA all report Arizona overdose deaths rising sharply (2,988 for 2025, up ~18%) while the nation fell ~14% — same entity, direction and near-identical count to our 2,980. The cocaine surge is also covered (AZPHA +70%, journal 177 to 294), so nothing countable is ours alone.
